headline: U.S. Strikes Iran, Fueling Oil Price Hikes and Regional Conflict Fears.
summary: Reports confirm U.S. military strikes against Iran, immediately driving up global oil prices and raising fears of broader regional conflict. This escalation directly impacts global energy supply chains and input costs for critical industries, including the AI and semiconductor sectors already facing inflationary pressures.

headline: Taiwan Mulls Tighter AI Chip Export Controls on China, Aligning with US Policy
summary: This potential regulatory shift intensifies the tech decoupling between the US and China, directly impacting AI infrastructure development in China and forcing global semiconductor fabs to re-evaluate supply chain strategies. The move escalates geopolitical tensions and further segments the global AI market, potentially accelerating indigenous chip development efforts by Beijing.

headline: Taiwan Mulls Curbs on AI Chip Exports to China to Align With US
summary: This potential regulatory shift by Taiwan directly escalates the US-China tech war, further limiting China's access to critical AI infrastructure and advanced semiconductors. It will force a significant re-evaluation of global AI supply chain strategies and deepen the geopolitical divide in high-tech manufacturing.

headline: Chinese Startup Claims DUV-Free Photonic Chip Production, Threatening Global Semiconductor Control Paradigms
summary: A Chinese startup alleges a nanoimprint process to produce photonic chips without DUV lithography, potentially cutting costs by 90% and allowing China to circumvent current Western semiconductor export controls. If validated, this breakthrough would fundamentally alter global semiconductor manufacturing, AI infrastructure supply chains, and geopolitical tech competition.
